Terms of Service
Last updated: September 7, 2026
Acceptance of Terms
Attendance Tracker ("the App") is operated by Kinetic Helix LLC ("we", "us", "our"). By installing or using the App, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, do not use the App.
Description of Service

The App is a Google Meet add-on that provides real-time attendance tracking during meetings; exports attendance reports to Google Sheets and PDF; issues per-attendee attendance certificates with a public verification page; can optionally deliver post-meeting summaries via email and to Slack, Google Chat, or Discord webhooks you configure; can export gradebook-formatted CSV files for import into learning-management systems such as Moodle and Canvas; and can optionally import class rosters from Google Classroom courses you teach. The App is available to any Google account with access to Google Meet, including personal Gmail accounts and Google Workspace accounts, and offers both a free plan and optional paid plans.
User Responsibilities, Two-Party Consent & Wiretapping Warranties
You must be the meeting organizer or have appropriate permissions and legal authority to track attendance, monitor participant join/leave times, and capture meeting logs in your jurisdiction.

Two-Party Consent & Recording Laws: Certain jurisdictions (including Florida pursuant to Fla. Stat. § 934.03, California under Cal. Penal Code § 632, and other US states and international territories) require the prior consent of all parties to monitor, record, or track communications. You expressly represent and warrant that you will provide conspicuous prior notice to and secure all required consents from all meeting participants before initiating attendance tracking. You agree to defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Kinetic Helix LLC from any claims or statutory liabilities arising from your failure to provide proper notice or secure required participant consents.

Student Data & Educational Compliance: If you use the App in an educational setting, you represent and warrant that your use complies with the Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA, 34 CFR Part 99), the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA, 15 U.S.C. §§ 6501–6506), and applicable state student privacy laws. See our Student Data Privacy Statement.

If you configure a Slack, Google Chat, or Discord webhook, you are solely responsible for choosing an internal, authorized channel or space where posting attendance data is legally permissible and compliant with organizational confidentiality policies.

If you share a public link to a recurring meeting series, the recipient will see participant names and attendance rates. You accept full responsibility for all data and links you distribute or export.

Attendance reports and certificates generated by the App reflect attendance logs recorded from Google Meet sessions. You are solely responsible for verifying their factual accuracy and for how you use, issue, or represent them for academic, grading, corporate payroll, continuing legal/medical education, or compliance purposes.
Data and Privacy
Your use of the App is also governed by our Privacy Policy and Student Data Privacy Policy. By using the App, you consent to the data practices described therein.
Paid Plans & Billing
The App offers a free plan and optional paid ("Pro") plans; paid features are described on our Pricing page.

Paid plans are billed through our payment processor, Stripe — either on a recurring basis (monthly or annually) or as a one-time purchase (such as a Lifetime Pass, which is a single charge that never renews). By purchasing, you authorize us to charge your payment method for the applicable fees, including any taxes where required.
Subscriptions renew automatically at the end of each billing period until you cancel. You may cancel at any time from your billing settings or by contacting us.
Fees are billed in advance and are non-refundable except as described in our Refund & Cancellation Policy.
We may change plan features or pricing. If we change the price of a plan you are subscribed to, we will provide notice, and the new price will apply from your next billing period.
